text:
maria: Heads-up — we need a new Grafana rollup for fleet SLOs that includes network-side signals. Current dashboards miss correlation between net egress spikes and GPU power draw.

josh: +1. We keep getting noisy thermal alerts that align with cross-rack traffic bursts. think a combined view would help. :thinking_face: 

lee: Agree. Proposal: a top row with per-region headroom (avg util, mem pressure, temp delta, PDU watts), then a heatmap of net_dev_bytes_total by rack. That way ops can see 'where' the traffic is hitting.

priya: For headroom, can we add a computed field: "gpu_headroom_pct = max(0, (target_util_pct - 95th_util_pct))" so alerts fire only when sustained. Also want to see KV-cache hit-rate overlay for hostnames serving batches.

maria: Good idea. Example PromQL snippets I was thinking: 
```
# 95th percentile GPU util per region over 5m
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(node_gpu_utilization_bucket[5m])) by (le, region))

# Network bytes/s per rack
sum(rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{device!~"lo|docker0"}[1m])) by (rack)
```

josh: For memory pressure: `nvidia_memory_used_bytes / nvidia_memory_total_bytes` per GPU, then `max()` over GPUs in a host to get host-level memory pressure.

lee: On alerts: reduce flapping by using `for: 10m` on thermal/power alerts and require both `gpu_temp` and `pdu_power` conditions. Example rule idea: 
```
- alert: GPUHighTempAndPower
  expr: (avg_over_time(gpu_temperature_celsius[10m]) > 85) and (avg_over_time(pdu_power_watts[10m]) > 1500)
  for: 10m
```

priya: Can we also tag dashboards by deployment mode (hosted/dedicated/private)? Some hosted tenants have bursty egress and we should separate those to avoid noisy tenant-level SLOs.

maria: Yes — add a `deployment_mode` variable in dashboard. Also want a small panel showing cost impact: estimated $/hour = sum(pdu_power_watts * USD_per_kWh / 1000) aggregated by region. Quick calc will help infra finance calls.

josh: FYI, Loki query to correlate pod restarts with high net egress: `rate(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[5m]) by (pod) |~ "network"` — we can pipe into overlay in Grafana Explore.

lee: Implementation note: avoid one big dashboard JSON; break into panels and use folder templating. Also use transform -> merge to create the headroom panel from multiple queries. Transforms work better when each query returns `region` label.

priya: For heatmap color stops, prefer thresholds: green < 60% util, amber 60-85, red >85 and white hatch if temp>88C. Makes ops triage faster.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: New dashboard draft pushed to staging: `fleet/slo-rollup-network-heatmap` (uid: stg_fleet_2026). Please review, Maria/Josh/Lee.

maria: Pushed review comments: simplified the PromQL, added `avg_over_time(...[15m])` for smoother lines. Also asked for per-tenant toggle.

josh: I adjusted the network query to exclude mgmt VLAN interfaces. Patch attached in staging dashboard JSON.

lee: Quick check — alert noise will drop if we require both `for:10m` and `evaluation_interval` bump to 1m for the alertmanager group. Otherwise we still get repeated notifications.

priya: One more: add a panel that correlates `instance:requests:rate` (hosted) with PDU power delta to show client-driven load vs infra issues. Could use `increase()` to capture spikes.

maria: Can someone add an annotation stream for infra deploys and network maintenance windows? Those often explain spikes and should prevent false positives.

josh: I'll add `grafana_annotations{source="deploy-bot"}` as an overlay.

lee: Next steps: finalize queries + transforms, tune alert `for` to 10m, add deployment_mode variable, and push to prod after 24h in staging. I'll create a PR with panel JSONs.

priya: If we still get noise after this, we should consider a machine-learning based anomaly detector on top of the headroom metric instead of static thresholds. Not for this sprint though.

maria: Sounds good — thanks everyone. Tagging @oncall for visibility. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: alert-bot: Note: existing alert `GPU_Temperature_High` suppressed during maintenance window 2026-06-12T02:00Z-04:00Z.

josh: Merged PR to staging. Will monitor for 12 hours and then promote if no regressions.

lee: Thx — will follow up with Grafana dashboard UID and dashboard folder placement.

priya: Added a short doc snippet under docs/grafana/gpu-observability.md with the PromQL examples and transform steps.

maria: Closing thread — follow-ups in the PR and staging dashboard. :rocket:
